name: org.identityhood/registry
title: IdentityHood
description: Check an AI agent's plate: is a human answering for it, and did they say go, pause or stop?

tools.name: check_plate
tools.description: Before acting for an agent, or trusting one, check its IdentityHood plate: is it claimed by a human, and did that human say go, pause or stop? Returns verdict and may_act.

name.description: The plate name, like gtr-6 (3 to 24 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes).

tools.name: get_plate_record
tools.description: The signed plate record and the signed rules file for a claimed plate, for verifying the signatures yourself.
